notes: Combination of two documented tricks: the stealer runs inside a hollowed Microsoft-signed System32 binary (Amatera / Rhadamanthys) and, like Storm, ships the encrypted stores for server-side decryption, so no DPAPI call happens. on_file() returns early for system-trusted readers, so nothing records the reads and ST-04 has no credential timestamp.
known_gap: system_trusted readers are skipped in on_file and nothing else records the reads
